    Three checks anyone can run — no trust required:

    How it works

    1 · Commit — when the week ends, we publish sha256(seed) and close the round: new chances go to next week. The seed stays secret.
    2 · Freeze — we publish every entry (wallet · chances) and only then pick a target future slot, so its blockhash doesn't exist until the entries are fixed and public.
    3 · Draw — once the slot finalizes, we take its on-chain blockhash (nobody controlled it), mix it with the seed, and pick winners weighted by chances. Then we reveal the seed.
    4 · Verify — check sha256(seed) equals the commitment (the seed wasn't swapped), the blockhash really is that slot's on-chain (the randomness was real & unpredictable), and re-run the pick on the published entries. Same inputs always give the same winners.
    Live from /api/draw. Blockhash checked against a public Solana RPC in your browser.
